notes.title: The Storyteller's Festival — Broadcast with commentary
notes.notes:
Hello, viewers!

TELEFORUM is taking part in The Storyteller's Festival 2024! And given the occasion, it's perfect opportunity for a re-run of the special program featuring the game’s writer — [b]Tiago Rech[/b]!

Join us [b]Tomorrow,  February 1st 9:00 pm Brazil Standard Time \\ February 2nd at 1:00 am CET[/b]!

This special broadcast will feature the walkthrough of the original version of TELEFORUM with the [b]Tiago Rech commentary[/b].

See you [b]February 1st 9:00 pm Brazil Standard Time \\ February 2nd at 1:00 am CET[/b]!

notes.title: [Ad Break] Introducing Outcast Tales: The First Journey
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear viewers!

While the COMUNITV crew is still hard at work on recovering footage from Drowned Lake, today we got a word from our friends at Hardlane Studio who just released the free prologue chapter to their upcoming game [i]Outcast Tales[/i], titled [i]Outcast Tales: The First Journey[/i].

[previewyoutube=T2JRPrdKnPA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/882590/Outcast_Tales_The_First_Journey/

[b]Outcast Tales[/b] is a turn-based tactical rogue-like gang of (un)likeable misfits trying to brave deadly Wastelands… and each other’s opinions. Mix and match the classes AND personalities of your crewmates, explore (and plunder) the Wastelands, fight formidable enemies and write your own Tale!

[list]
[*] Outcast Tales: The First Journey is a [b]completely free to play[/b] first chapter of Outcast Tales
[*] Audio narration for the events, done by Samuel Barnett — the famous Dirk Gently  from [b]Dirk Gently’s Holistic Detective Agency[/b] and [b]Delamain[/b] from [b]Cyberpunk 2077[/b]!
[*] [b]Contracts[/b]: a series of side-quests that you can complete across multiple playthroughs and unlock new gear, abilities and even new classes and personalities
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] — interact with your friends or viewers through a [b]multitude of features![/b]
[/list]

If you want to learn more about Outcast Tales or wish to chat with other wastelanders, consider following Outcast Tales on X [i](formerly known as Twitter)[/i], joining CRITICAL REFLEX Discord and wishlisting the full game on Steam to be the first to play it!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551970/Outcast_Tales/


[i]This message was brought to you by the CR Channel. Join our terrifyingly good Discord community, where we're all about horrors![/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/qZVKcJQkyv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/a76ad436b7bf7f86a2bf227d2b183c6db9a9bf59.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: TELEFORUM is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear viewers.

We have a special report for you today: [b]TELEFORUM is now officially Steam Deck Verified[/b]. 

This opens up infinite possibilities for watching the forbidden tape, so we at [b]COMUNITV[/b] decided to give you a few ideas:

[list]
[*] [b]Watch TELEFORUM on a plane. [/b]It’s a perfectly suitable feature-length experience for shorter flights, after all.
[*] [b]Watch TELEFORUM in your bed. [/b]Recommended for those who want to keep dreaming about TELEFORUM during sleep.
[*] [b]Watch TELEFORUM during an interview of a grieving widow.[/b] Wait, don’t you also need to hold the camera?
[*] [b]Watch TELEFORUM on a fishing boat. [/b]Make sure to wear headphones and don’t make a sound.
[*] [b]Watch TELEFORUM.[/b]
[*] [b]Don’t stop watching TELEFORUM.[/b]
[*] [b]Show TELEFORUM to your loved ones.[/b]
[*] [b]BECOME ONE WITH TELEFORUM.[/b]
[*] [b]THE PROGRAMME IS NEVER OVER.[/b]
[*] [spoiler][b]NOVOMUNDO[/b][/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Free update TELEFORUM: DELETED SCENES available now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kfwK7am.gif[/img]

Dear viewers,

To celebrate the announcement of our next game — [b]DROWNED LAKE[/b] — we are releasing a free content update for [b]TELEFORUM[/b] — a director’s cut of sorts. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186570/TELEFORUM/

We hope you’ll enjoy [b]TELEFORUM: DELETED SCENES[/b] and uncover the secrets the ◊◊◊◊◊◊◊◊◊ didn’t want you to see. 

[i]Warning: multiple people have reported cases of false memory after watching DELETED SCENES. Almost as if… the tape itself was recording and re-recording some of its older versions. Viewer discretion is advised.[/i]

————————————

[h2]COMING UP NEXT ON COMUNITV: DROWNED LAKE[/h2]

[previewyoutube=w9SHWqIj45A;full][/previewyoutube]

Unravel the truth of the [b]Drowned Lake[/b] in a non-linear horror story inspired by the legends and nightmares of Brazilian folklore. Explore your haunting surroundings by boat, collect lost evidence with a fishing rod, solve puzzles in first-person POV, and try to avoid disturbing these troubled waters. Don’t let the Drowned Lake fool you. [i]Remember: you're not safe here![/i]

[h2]Add the next Monumental Collab game to your wishlist:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601540/DROWNED_LAKE

[i]P.S. A lot of people in the community were asking us for an option to support TELEFORUM, so we’re also launching the TELEFORUM: SUPPORTER PACK for our dear viewers at home. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690730/TELEFORUM__Supporter_Pack/

Inside you will find:
[list]
[*] [b]A digital artbook. [/b]Take a peek behind the curtain of TELEFORUM development and our approach to the horror genre as a whole. Partly Monumental Collab’s manifest, partly a deconstruction of TELEFORUM — that’s our gift to the most dedicated of our viewers.
[*] [b]TELEFORUM Original Soundtrack. [/b]Ambient tunes to interview grieving widows to. Composed by Nickolas “Kaedalus” Jaques, available in MP3 and WAV.
[*] [b]TELEFORUM Wallpapers.[/b] Take TELEFORUM everywhere with you. Become one with TELEFORUM. The programme is never over.
[/list][/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/qZVKcJQkyv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/a76ad436b7bf7f86a2bf227d2b183c6db9a9bf59.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 - nominate TELEFORUM for Outstanding Story-Rich Game
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, dear viewers![/h3]

We once again thank you for all the amazing support you’ve showed for TELEFORUM! If you have already experienced and enjoyed the mystery of Walter Martin, [b]consider nominating TELEFORUM for the Outstanding Story-Rich Game category[/b] during [url=https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards]Steam Awards 2023[/url]. If you’ve already nominated another game, [b]you can always show your appreciation of our work by leaving a review.[/b]

And in case you’ve yet to uncover the truth behind Walter Martin’s TELEFORUM — now is the best time to play it! The game is [b]absolutely free to play[/b] and we believe that its story is well worth your time.

notes.title: Coming Up Next: “A Heartfelt Thank You”
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pB4taRM.gif[/img]

[b]Dear viewers,

We wanted to step out of character for a bit to thank everyone who dared to venture into the world of TELEFORUM over the past few days. As of writing this text, our little game has reached over 100k library additions on Steam, and this number keeps growing!

So whether you played it, streamed it, watched someone's playthrough, struggled with the last achievement, memed about Julian(n)a, or theorized about the lore — we're humbled by the overwhelming terror and excitement around our first Big Steam Launch, and we're immensely grateful to every single one of you for the support!

In the coming days, we'll share some bits and pieces of TELEFORUM's behind-the-scenes, so please stay tuned. But don't expect any answers for the lore questions just yet. Some secrets are better left buried. [spoiler](̶͕̼͚̜̮̳̤͇͖̥͍͌̍͛̕͠͝ͅf̵̬̹̭̙͕̗̥̘̜͙̰̪͇̓̾̄̉̈͂̀͒̀̋͂͜͠͝͝ó̶̥̪̪̹͕͚͈͐r̴̦̈́̒̽̀̍̋̽̚͘͠ ̷̰̌̐̊̎̉̀͌͑̌̂n̴̳̹̐̐́̊́͂̉͌o̸͎̘̭̱̞̲̺̻̳̩̯̮̺͕͙͛̀͌̋̂̔̔̎̌̐̎͌̊w̴̛̯̳̾͐͂̎̄̍̾̇͌̌̓͘͘͝)̵͎͈̲̟̬̾͑͛̇͗͑͐͘[/spoiler]

As for what's next for our team, we're already hard at work for our next project set in the same universe — DROWNED LAKE. Some of you may have seen the prototype we previously made for a game jam, but this time, we're even more ambitious, and we can't wait to share more info about it soon!

See you next time, dear viewers... if you dare.[/b]

[b]Oh, and one last thing:[/b] [spoiler]If you haven't, type T124 into the Elevator for a secret scene, just a little extra thank-you from us... or is it a warning?[/spoiler]

[url=https://discord.gg/qZVKcJQkyv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/a76ad436b7bf7f86a2bf227d2b183c6db9a9bf59.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: TELEFORUM broadcast — airing Today!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear audiences!

We hope that you’re enjoying re-living the best moments of your favorite show — TELEFORUM, — in our NEXT fest demo! Our crew decided to prepare something extra for the occasion and air a special broadcast with none other than one of the show’s creators. 

[b]Today,  October 13th 9:00 pm BST \\ October 14th at 2:00 am CET[/b], join us for a special program featuring the show’s writer — [b]Tiago Rech[/b]!

Not only you will get to experience TELEFORUM together with them, but also have a chance to take a glimpse behind the the scenes and ask questions about the show!

See you [b]October 13th 9:00 pm BST \\ October 14th at 2:00 am CET[/b]!
